verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Wangfujing, steps from the Forbidden City and Tiananmen Square.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled in the heart of Wangfujing, and just steps from the Forbidden City and Tiananmen Square

verified_facts.text: The address is 8 Goldfish Lane, Wangfujing, Beijing.
verified_facts.excerpt: 8 Goldfish Lane, Wangfujing, Beijing 100006, People's Republic of China

verified_facts.text: The hotel is an all-suite property pairing residential layouts with contemporary Chinese art.
verified_facts.excerpt: Beijing’s premier all-suite address pairs spacious residential layouts with contemporary Chinese art, considered craftsmanship and intuitive Peninsula touches.

verified_facts.text: Duplex Suites stretch across two stories.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stretching across two stories, our Duplex suites offer a unique experience in Beijing and the feel of a luxury residence.

verified_facts.text: Wangfujing Suites have a bathroom with a view of Wangfujing.
verified_facts.excerpt: suites offer respite from the hustle and bustle of Beijing, while the sumptuous bathroom with a view of Wangfujing still adds a touch of the city.

verified_facts.text: The Peninsula Suite is designed to resemble a Chinese aristocrat's courtyard home in old Beijing.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Suite has been designed to resemble the palatial home of a Chinese aristocrat in a traditional courtyard house in old Beijing, yet with a distinctly contemporary approach.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's three restaurants are The Lobby, Huang Ting and Yun Summer Lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: The three beautifully styled restaurants at The Peninsula Beijing – The Lobby, Huang Ting and Yun Summer Lounge

verified_facts.text: Huang Ting reinterprets the courtyard houses of Beijing's nobility, with Qing dynasty antiques and silk accents.
verified_facts.excerpt: Huang Ting reinterprets the traditional courtyard houses of Beijing's nobility and the meals that would have been enjoyed there. Qing dynasty antiques and silk accents in ivory and blue are an elegant celebration of heritage.

verified_facts.text: Huang Ting's menu moves between Cantonese classics and regional Chinese specialties, from dim sum to Peking duck.
verified_facts.excerpt: The menu moves between Cantonese classics and regional Chinese specialties, from dim sum to Peking duck and seasonal dishes

verified_facts.text: The Huang Ting Tea Lounge serves more than 20 varieties of tea, with a resident tea master preparing tastings in the style of a traditional Chinese tea ceremony.
verified_facts.excerpt: It serves more than 20 varieties of tea and sweet dim sum, and the resident tea master will offer seasonal samplings and tastings theatrically prepared in front of guests in the style of a traditional Chinese tea ceremony.

verified_facts.text: Yun Summer Lounge offers open-air dining and cocktails.
verified_facts.excerpt: Open-air dining and cocktails, designed for creating summer memories

verified_facts.text: The indoor swimming pool is heated to 28 degrees Celsius year round.
verified_facts.excerpt: which is heated to 28 degrees celsius year round ensuring the utmost comfort for guests

verified_facts.text: The spa offers treatments inspired by Ayurvedic, European and Asian healing philosophies, with spa suites for couples and thermal bathing facilities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Indulge your desires with modern and traditional treatments inspired by Ayurvedic, European and Asian healing philosophies. Beautifully styled Spa suites for couples create an ambience of privacy and peace, and thermal bathing facilities

verified_facts.text: The hotel was the first in China to collaborate with skincare brand Biologique Recherche.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Beijing is the first hotel in China to collaborate with luxury skincare brand Biologique Recherche

verified_facts.text: The spa does not accept children under 16.
verified_facts.excerpt: Children under 16 years of age are not accepted.

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre has cardiovascular and strength-training machines.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Fitness Centre is fully equipped with a wide range of cardiovascular and strength-training machines

verified_facts.text: Guests can ride Peninsula bicycles through Beijing, complimentary for in-house guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary for in-house guests daily between 8:00 am and 8:00 pm

verified_facts.text: Bicycle routes take in the hutongs of the old town and imperial landmarks.
verified_facts.excerpt: From the winding hutongs of the old town to the grandeur of imperial landmarks, each ride becomes a personal journey through history and heritage.

verified_facts.text: The Peninsula Kid's Passport Adventure takes young guests on a guided exploration of the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our youngest guests are invited on a playful journey through the hotel’s most iconic spaces. With interactive questions and guided exploration, every moment becomes a memory.

verified_facts.text: Huang Ting hosts cultural sessions such as tea rituals and artisan crafts for guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests can explore the rich traditions of Huang Ting through tea ceremonies and handcraft workshops

verified_facts.text: The hotel has an art gallery on the third floor with rotating exhibitions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy our in-house gallery, where rotating exhibitions showcase a blend of contemporary vision and local artistry.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's fleet includes six BMW 7 Series saloons for airport transfers and private hire.
verified_facts.excerpt: This includes six BMW 7 Series saloons.

verified_facts.text: The Peninsula Arcade has grown to three levels with over 30 brands.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Arcade has grown to three levels, housing over 30 time-honoured brands under one roof.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is 27.4 km from Beijing Capital International Airport and 52 km from Beijing Daxing International Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: 27.4 km (16.9 miles) from Beijing Capital International Airport / 52 Km (32.3 miles) from Beijing Daxing International Airport

verified_facts.text: Smoking is banned in all indoor areas and there are no smoking guest rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Beijing is no longer able to offer smoking guest rooms while all indoor areas including all restaurants have also been re-designated as non-smoking area.

verified_facts.text: Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult while swimming.
verified_facts.excerpt: Children under 12 years must be accompanied by an adult while swimming
